data.title: I turned my security cameras into an automatic bird identification system
data.author: speckx
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了 BirdNet-Go：一款可通过 Docker 部署在本地服务器或树莓派上的实时鸟类、蝙蝠及其他野生动物声音识别工具。它支持 IP 摄像头 RTSP 音频、多模型推理、物种提醒、新物种追踪、Discord、Home Assistant 和 BirdWeather 集成。系统无需云服务，能充分利用现有监控设备，帮助用户长期记录庭院生物多样性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：利用安防摄像头、树莓派和音频模型进行鸟类及动物识别，并将结果用于家庭监测、展示和户外记录。

不同观点：
• **摄像头复用派**：ben1040、inventor7777、dewey等利用UniFi或Reolink的RTSP音频流运行BirdNET-Go，部署方便，可同时监测鸟类、蛙类；但dewey指出物种识别准确率仍不理想。  
• **专用麦克风派**：maciejb认为摄像头内置麦克风容易受风噪影响，且Aqara仅支持16kHz，而BirdNET更适合48kHz，因此改用外接麦克风和树莓派，音质明显改善。  
• **便携与可视化派**：tacodestroyer将BirdNET-Pi做成便携设备，用电子墨水屏显示当日Top 3、最近识别和总数；ben1040、simenf也计划或已经将鸟类识别结果做成木刻风格或电视艺术展示。  
• **谨慎使用派**：som指出BirdNET在澳大利亚常给出低概率且可能受地域偏差影响的错误识别，但也能识别同一合唱中的多种鸟，因此需要人工核验。doodlebugging进一步关注蝙蝠识别所需的更高采样率。  
• **扩展到其他动物与场景**：有人将摄像头用于动物行为分析、运动录像回放或宠物行为提醒；也有人推荐Merlin Bird ID、eBird、Xeno-canto及Spoor等相关工具。

补充讨论：争议焦点主要是识别准确性、音频采样率与硬件适配，而非项目可行性；评论整体倾向于认为该方案有趣实用，但应结合人工判断。

49511856.article_content:
My wife loves listening to the birds and identifying them using an app on her phone. I thought I'd take this a step further and see if there was something that can identify the birds based on their song. Looking around I found BirdNet and
BirdNet-Go
, then discovered you can run this on Docker and use the security cameras you already have outside to identify the birds. Awesome! So I took 3 of the cameras around my house and used their microphones to identify the birds. It was magic.
Real-Time Bird and Bat Audio Detection
BirdNet-Go runs 24/7. It listens constantly. The moment a bird starts singing, it analyzes the audio and gives you an identification. No waiting, no manual recording. It works for bats too, which is pretty cool if you've got them flying around at dusk. The system just keeps running in the background, cataloging everything it hears. It also started detecting frogs which is interesting.
Multi-Model Local AI Inference Engine
The whole thing runs locally on your hardware. No cloud services. No API calls. The AI models live right on your server or Raspberry Pi. This means it's fast, private, and doesn't cost you anything per month. You can even run multiple models if you want different detection strategies or regional bird databases. They recently added Google Perch v2 to the model gallery allowing for 14,795 species to be detected vs the 6,000 that BirdNET 2.4 provided.
Alert Rules with Species List Matching
You can set up rules for specific birds. Want to know the instant a cardinal shows up? Done. Looking for a rare species in your area? Set an alert. The system matches against species lists and sends you notifications based on whatever criteria you set. It's like having a birding buddy who never sleeps. I even have it connected to a channel in my homes Discord server. Wait, your house doesn't have a dedicated Discord?
Setting up notifications and alerts for bird sightings into the house discord channel #birdnet
Species Novelty Tracking for New Detections
This feature tracks which birds are new to your yard. First time a blue jay visits? BirdNet-Go flags it. It maintains a running list of every species it's detected, so you can see your yard's biodiversity grow over time. Honestly, this turned into a fun game for us.
RTSP Stream Support for IP Cameras
If your cameras support RTSP, you're good to go. Most modern IP cameras do. You just point BirdNet-Go at the stream URL. I used three of my existing security cameras. Didn't need to buy any special hardware. The cameras I already had for security now pull double duty identifying birds.
BirdWeather Integration for Data Sharing
BirdWeather is a community platform for sharing bird detection data. BirdNet-Go integrates with it directly. If you want to contribute your observations to a larger dataset, you can. It helps researchers and other birders see what's happening in your area. You don't have to use it, but it's nice that the option exists.
Self-Hosted with No Cloud Dependencies
Everything lives on your network. The audio never leaves your house unless you explicitly share it. No subscription fees. No terms of service changes. No company shutting down the service in two years. You own the whole stack. It runs in Docker, so it's easy to manage alongside everything else in your homelab.
Can connect to Home Assistant
Evernything needs to be able to connect to Home Assistant and BirdNET-Go can use MQTT to be discovered in Home Assistant.
Visual Audio Channel Energy Level Analysis
The interface shows you real-time audio levels for each channel. You can see exactly what the microphones are picking up. This helps you position cameras better or troubleshoot why one isn't detecting anything. Sometimes you'll realize the camera is pointed at a noisy AC unit or getting wind noise, and you can adjust accordingly.
Final Thoughts
Look, this project surprised me. I expected it to be neat but figured I'd get bored after a week. Instead, my wife and I check it daily. We've learned which birds visit at what times. We've spotted species we didn't know lived nearby. My friends got interested too, I made this avaiable on the public house domain name (behind Cloudflare of course.) and allowed a few of my friends to connect to it and see how it works.  It turned our security camera setup into something genuinely useful beyond security. If you've got cameras with microphones and even a passing interest in birds, give BirdNet-Go a shot. It's one of those homelab projects that actually improves daily life instead of just being technically interesting.

data.title: RavynOS: Pre-alpha open-source OS based on Darwin, FreeBSD, Apple open-source
data.author: Bluestein
data.article_summary: ravynOS旨在将macOS的优秀体验带到开源系统中，提供简洁美观的界面、全局菜单、统一快捷键、拖放式应用安装、熟悉的目录结构、Cocoa API支持及实用终端命令。同时，项目欢迎用户通过Wiki、GitHub讨论区和Discord参与建设。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕 ravynOS 这一兼容 macOS、基于 Darwin/FreeBSD 的开源操作系统项目，讨论其技术价值、应用兼容性、发展成熟度及生态选择。

不同观点：
• 技术价值：有人质疑 Darwin 相比 BSD 和 Linux 的独特优势，认为核心吸引力主要是兼容 macOS 应用；也有人认为其 Cocoa/API 兼容目标本身就具有重要价值。  
• 项目成熟度：部分评论期待截图或更多成果，认为目前缺乏实际体验依据；另一方指出项目仅约五年、规模很小，仍能取得现有成果已相当出色。  
• 应用兼容性：开发者称 Cocoa 应用只需少量修改即可移植，但评论追问“接近兼容”与完整兼容之间的实际差距，认为原生运行 macOS 软件将显著降低迁移门槛。  
• 法律与实现：有人担心使用 Darwin 代码及兼容苹果专有 API 的法律风险；回应认为可参考 ReactOS、GNUstep、Darling，通过从头重实现规避问题，但若项目成功到引起苹果关注，风险可能上升。  
• 硬件路线：有人疑惑项目仍以 x86 为主，ARM 支持有限，质疑其对新款苹果硬件的适配能力及 Darwin 是否仍在更新。  
• 生态与协作：有人批评 Discord 沟通及开源项目碎片化，期待统一发行版、兼容层、图形 API 和包管理器；也有人质疑苹果生态“越来越封闭”的说法，认为其长期变化并不明显。

补充讨论：评论还涉及项目命名、与 PureDarwin 的开发者关联，以及类似项目的历史与比较。

49511534.article_content:
Project Goals
Features that you'd love.
We intend to bring many of the features you've come to love from macOS to ravynOS such as clean design, global menus, and drag-and-drop installs.
design_services
Clean Design
A distract-free interface that puts your content first. Beautiful transparency, refined typography, and elegant spacing inspired by the best.
top_panel_open
Global Menus
Save vertical space and access commands consistently. The global menu bar separates application control from window content.
keyboard_command_key
Consistent Shortcuts
Muscle memory matters. Use the standard Command-key shortcuts you already know and love across the entire system.
drag_indicator
Simple Installs
No installers, no registries. Just drag the application bundle to your Applications folder and you're done.
folder
Familiar Folders
Feel at home with a standard hierarchy: Applications, System, Library, and Users. Everything is exactly where you expect it.
api
Cocoa APIs
Native support for key frameworks. Developers can port existing Cocoa applications with minimal changes.
terminal
Nifty Commands
Power at your fingertips. Use 'open', 'pbcopy', and other familiar terminal utilities to speed up your workflow.
Get Involved
Don't be shy, come talk.
If this sounds like your dream system, please help us make it a reality! We've got a Discord.

data.title: ChatGPT Work Tool and Skill Reference
data.author: ijidak
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一个工具与技能清单快照，包含232个可调用工具接口和44个完整技能文件。内容涵盖文档、图表、图片、PDF、演示文稿、电子表格、可视化、浏览器操作、网站构建与托管，以及用户交互和文件库管理等领域，并说明了各技能的适用场景与使用限制。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕 ChatGPT Work 的技能机制、与 Codex 的差异、使用体验及安全信任展开讨论。

不同观点：
• 机制探究：有人认为最有趣的是 `control-browser` 技能。它通过 Node.js REPL 调用 `browser.documentation()` 获取完整说明，评论者希望了解为何不直接写入技能 Markdown 文件。  
• 效率质疑：有人指出部分“工作工具”会拖慢流程、浪费大量 token，质疑其实际收益。  
• 产品差异疑问：有人认为若 Codex 已能完成相同任务，就不清楚 ChatGPT Work 的独特价值。  
• 设计同质化：有人注意到 AI 生成的网站、制品和报告具有类似 Bootstrap 时代的统一风格，追问是否存在共同设计规范。  
• 使用体验反馈：有人希望增加常规屏幕网站测试，并指出左侧栏无法独立滚动，屏幕较小时无法查看列表下半部分。  
• 安全与信任批评：有人基于 Sam Altman 过往争议、OpenAI 安全职能弱化及相关运营和技术问题，认为使用 ChatGPT Work 是严重错误。

补充讨论：部分评论提供了相关文章背景或标注为重复讨论；争议焦点主要是工具的实际独特性、效率提升，以及 OpenAI 的安全和治理可信度。

49510000.article_content:
About this inventory
Tools are callable endpoints; skills are reusable instruction packages that guide how those tools are used. This snapshot contains
232
tool interfaces and
44
complete main skill files.
Skill pages reproduce their complete current
SKILL.md
source. The tool reference preserves the exposed descriptions and TypeScript declarations. Availability can change with session configuration, permissions, connected apps, and installed plugins.
SKILLS
Complete skill source
Every available skill has its own page containing a verbatim copy of its main definition.
44
pages
Documents & visuals
10
answers-charts
Use when a chart would communicate a categorical comparison, trend, composition, or numeric relationship more clearly than prose.
→
answers-images
Use when retrieved images would visually ground or meaningfully improve an answer.
→
answers-learning
Use when the user explicitly requests flashcards, an objective multiple-choice knowledge quiz, or pronunciation help and an interactive learning widget would improve the answer.
→
documents
Create, edit, redline, and comment on `.docx`, Word, and Google Docs-targeted document artifacts inside the container, with a strict render-and-verify workflow. Use `render_docx.py` to generate page PNGs (and optional PDF) for visual QA, then iterate until layout is flawless before delivering the final document.
→
imagegen
Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas.
→
pdf
Read, create, inspect, render, and verify PDF files where visual layout matters, including fillable AcroForms. Use Poppler rendering plus Python tools such as reportlab, pdfplumber, and pypdf for generation and extraction.
→
Presentations
Read, create or edit PowerPoint or Google Slides decks. Use for presentation, slide deck, PowerPoint, PPT, PPTX, or Google Slides requests.
→
Spreadsheets
Use this skill when a user requests to create, modify, analyze, visualize, or work with spreadsheet files (`.xlsx`, `.xls`, `.csv`, `.tsv`) or Google Sheets-targeted spreadsheet artifacts with formulas, formatting, charts, tables, and recalculation.
→
visualize
Create visualizations and interactive tools directly in conversation. Proactively use to show how something works; explore 'what happens when', 'what changes', or 'help me understand'; compare or inspect; create simulations, maps, charts, graphs, and mockups. Use standard tools for static scientific figures.
→
writing-blocks
Present complete drafts of requested text in a writing block, including emails, messages, social posts, bios, blurbs, statements, and individual paragraphs. Prefer creating or editing a file for standalone documents or long-form content instead of a writing block.
→
Browser & Sites
4
control-browser
Control a browser for authenticated or public web tasks requiring live site state or interaction. For selecting a sign-in method or entering sign-in credentials, use only the advertised `browserAuth` capability. For public lookups, use web search first; NEVER fall back to Browser if search fails. Use Browser only when successful search lacks necessary data or direct site interaction is required. ALWAYS prefer applicable plugins; NEVER fall back to Browser if one is unavailable or fails.
→
sites:sites-building
Use Sites to build websites, including landing pages, portfolios, dashboards, portals, trackers, hubs, and internal tools. Always use Sites when the project contains `.openai/hosting.json`.
→
sites:sites-hosting
Host websites with Sites. Use with `sites-building` for Site registration, publishing, and deployment verification, or for hosting management without changing source.
→
sites:sites-preview-troubleshooting
Diagnose and recover when a Sites agent preview cannot start, become healthy, or open in the cloud browser after sites-building runs sites-preview.
→
Context & interaction
4
demos:answers-ask-user-input
Use when a small amount of missing context would materially improve the answer and tappable options plus a free-text answer can gather it efficiently.
→
openai-library:library
Use ChatGPT Library when the user mentions their Library, asks to find or work with a Library-backed file, Site, or named file that may be in the Library, or wants to organize Library folders, restore a previous version, or share an owned native Library file or folder. data.title: Launch HN: Almanac (YC S26) – AI that knows your company
data.author: kushagrchitkar
data.article_summary: Almanac是一款面向企业的智能代理，连接邮件、Slack、项目管理等工具，持续学习员工、客户和项目动态，自动整理成可更新、可追溯的公司知识库。它拥有独立电脑和登录权限，能跨工具执行任务、主动发现待办并汇报结果，同时在登录、付款或重要决策时请求确认。用户可查看、编辑知识库，权限和数据访问均可控制。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕企业/个人“AI知识库或Wiki代理”的独特性、可靠性、权限治理及商业价值展开讨论。

不同观点：
• 价值认可但要求验证：预编译Wiki可能提升长期任务的可预测性；应与Markdown仓库配合Claude/Codex比较任务完成率、引用准确率、过时信息错误及维护成本，并展示特殊记忆机制的实际数据。
• 差异化不足：有人认为Claude、Codex已具备大部分能力，核心优势应是多模型、企业自带API密钥及模型部署地点（尤其是否使用中国模型）；也有人列出大量竞品，质疑产品新颖性。
• 知识范围应更灵活：相比“个人/全公司”两级Wiki，更需要“个人—团队—部门—公司”的层级或知识图谱。
• 企业治理是关键：权限隔离、离职或撤权后的内容清除、邮件删除后的同步时效，可能比模型列表更重要；有人将其类比为非微软技术栈的 WorkIQ。
• ROI存在争议：有人认为高质量文档本身已解决运营问题，产品只是让员工“提问代替查找”；7天试用期也可能不足以形成有效记忆。
• 工程与合规疑问：浏览器登录工具涉及2FA、会话持久化及违反服务条款风险；另有用户推荐开源项目并询问实习机会。

补充讨论：网站信息不足，且动画导致页面内容跳动，影响阅读。

An agent that really knows
your company
Connect your tools. Almanac learns your people, your customers, your projects, and what matters right now.
The wiki that self-updates
Work happens in your tools. Almanac compiles it into a wiki, then reads it before doing anything.

A computer of its own
A real computer, with its own browser, files, and logins. Even the tools without an integration, Almanac just signs in and uses like you would.

Proactively gets things done for you
Almanac uses your connected tools and its wiki to notice what needs doing, do it, and tell you when it’s done.
Questions
Asked and
answered.
What can it actually access?
Only the accounts you connect. Almanac reads them to keep the wiki current and acts through them to get work done. Every connection is visible, and you can revoke any of them.
Do my teammates see my stuff?
No. An account you connect stays usable only by you. What flows into the shared wiki is the useful understanding: the decision, not your inbox. Shared accounts are added explicitly by the organization.
Can I read and edit the wiki myself?
Yes. It’s a real wiki. Browse it, correct it, add to it. Almanac keeps it current; your edits are part of what it knows.
What if the wiki is wrong?
Every line links back to its source, so you can check the receipt. Correct the page and Almanac works from the correction from then on.
Does it act without asking me?
It works on what you hand it, and it notices things worth doing on its own. But at a login, a payment, or a decision it shouldn't make alone, it pings you first — or hands you the live browser. You can watch every step of a run.
Is this just a chatbot with integrations?
Integrations fetch on demand; they don’t remember. Almanac maintains the wiki continuously and works from a computer of its own, so it starts already caught up and keeps going after you leave.
Why not just run Claude or Codex on my laptop?
You can — until you close the lid. Almanac runs on its own always-on computer, stays signed into your tools, and keeps a wiki of your context that is still there tomorrow. You delegate; it reports back.
Does my laptop need to stay open?
No. Almanac runs on its own machine. Start from the app, Slack, or your texts, close the device, and the finished work finds you.
Does it replace Notion, Linear, or Slack?
No. Your team keeps working where it already works. Almanac connects to those tools, learns from them, and acts across them.
Give your company an Almanac.
Get started for free

data.title: Launch HN: Hebbian Robotics (YC S26) – Build scalable robotics data pipelines
data.author: kstonekuan
data.article_summary: HFlow是Hebbian Robotics推出的开源机器人与物理AI多模态数据管道SDK，旨在解决数据处理、质量控制、版本追踪和复现困难。它以MCAP为输入输出边界，支持自定义Python转换、检查、标注与 enriquecement，并通过Airflow编排、DuckDB筛选和Parquet目录管理数据，记录完整溯源信息，帮助团队高效完成数据采集、清洗、质检、整理和交付。目前项目处于预1.0阶段。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕 HFlow 在机器人团队中的商业化落地、使用流程与可扩展性展开讨论。

不同观点：
• [pj_mukh] 持谨慎质疑态度：机器人核心工程团队常有“自己开发工具”的倾向，因此关注如何向机器人公司销售、是否已有突破这类采用障碍的经验。
• [ZeroCool2u2] 表示明确兴趣，尤其想将其用于 HuggingFace 新型机器人，并希望看到从 HFlow 数据集创建、模型训练到部署的完整演示，重点关注实际工作流。
• [dostick] 提出基础性质疑：“机器人如何实现可扩展”，可能在追问方案能否支持更多机器人、数据或团队规模，但未进一步说明具体担忧。
• [hnvd8v0o2d] 仅表示会收藏或留待日后关注，未表达明确立场。

补充讨论：评论整体从“市场 adoption 难题”延伸到“端到端使用证据”和“规模化能力”。主要争议焦点是：相比机器人团队自研，HFlow 是否能提供足够明显的效率或工程价值，以及其方案能否真正规模化。

Hebbian Robotics (YC S26)
HFlow
Open source SDK for scalable multimodal data pipelines in robotics and physical AI
Hebbian Robotics (YC S26) is building HFlow, an open source SDK for scalable
multimodal data pipelines in robotics and physical AI. It makes data tooling and
practices typically developed inside large robotics teams accessible to teams of
any size.
We believe processing data is a major bottleneck in robotics. A corpus can combine
video, state, actions, timestamps, and metadata from many recording systems. Teams
often feel the problem first in quality control: determining whether cameras froze,
streams drifted out of sync, required topics disappeared, or duplicate recordings
entered the corpus. As the corpus grows, fragmented scripts make it difficult to
know what ran, audit the results, or reproduce a dataset.
Teams can start with HFlow's built-in checks, write new transformations, checks,
labels, and enrichments, or connect processing code they already use. HFlow handles
the orchestration, storage, versioning, and curation around those steps.
HFlow stamps each processed episode with its provenance, renders the pipeline
as a graph, and records metadata and quality evidence in a queryable catalog.
You can trace how outputs were produced, monitor every stage, and
investigate a corpus without loading the underlying recordings.
MCAP is HFlow's v1 input and output boundary because it efficiently stores
and serves synchronized video, state, action, and other time-series streams.
That format requirement does not define where the data comes from: human-worn
cameras, teleoperated robots, autonomous policies, and other collection systems
can all feed the pipeline once their data is represented as a supported MCAP
episode.
Status: pre-v1, with the core lifecycle working end to end.
HFlow is ready to try locally. See
what is implemented
and
open issues
for current details and remaining work.
Help grow the open robotics community.
Star the repository
, share it with your network, or
contribute
. Our goal is an open source community where anyone can participate in building the future of robotics. No robot hardware is required to contribute.
HFlow's boundary
Input
Supported standard MCAP episodes directly; LeRobot Dataset v3 repositories through
hflow import lerobot
Processing
Your Python transforms, checks, labels, and enrichments
Execution
In-process for development; generated Airflow 3 DAGs for scheduled runs
Durable output
Canonical MCAP episodes, provenance, artifacts, and a Parquet catalog
Curation
DuckDB SQL that writes a version-pinned manifest
What you get
Human and robot data move through a four-stage lifecycle:
collection --> ingestion ---------------> curation ------> delivery
(landing       (transform -> QC gate ->  (SQL over        (curated MCAP +
bucket)        enrich, as an             episode          manifest; convert
Airflow DAG)              catalog)         for training)
Your processing code stays yours.
Transformations, quality checks, labels, and enrichments are plain Python functions in your own environment. Existing code plugs in through small adapters instead of being rewritten for a proprietary framework.
Episodes are MCAP
, the container that ROS 2 records natively and
Foxglove
/
Rerun
open directly, written with two tunings described in Dyna's article: in-band H.264 with GOP length matched to how the data is read, and
topic-group chunking
(camera streams and state streams never share a chunk, so a training sample costs one read per group instead of one per topic).
Processed episodes carry their provenance.
The file itself records the schema, pipeline, and tool versions that produced it, plus its source URI when available. Catalog records connect measurements and outcomes to step versions, making it easier to trace a bad result back to its origin.
The pipeline is visible as a graph.
HFlow renders Airflow DAGs so you can see how stages connect and monitor task status, logs, retries, and reruns.
Quality checks produce reusable evidence.
Accessors extract the inputs existing proc

主要讨论点：评论围绕“疯蜜”（含灰叶毒素的杜鹃花蜜）的来源、药理风险、文化采集方式及消费安全展开。

不同观点：
• 科普与资料补充：多人分享《The Conversation》原文、Vice及法语纪录片，补充其采集过程、仪式文化和历史传播；有人联想到《Futurama》的“太空蜜蜂”情节。  
• 风险警示：评论认为普通消费者可能误以为是蜂蜜而过量食用；也有人指出，购买在线精神活性物质者应自行确认成分和剂量，并提到相关产品已形成从尼泊尔到消费者的供应链。  
• 对毒性表述的质疑：有人质疑“药用剂量与致死剂量间隔很小”的依据，认为现有大鼠研究未充分比较剂量；争议焦点是风险是否被夸大，以及降血压是否呈线性效应。  
• 传统知识与适应性推测：有人推测当地人可能经过代际积累形成耐受性，而不只是掌握经验；但这属于推断，未有证据支持。  
• 真实性与替代品：有人怀疑产品是否可靠，联想到掺入伟哥的“壮阳蜜”；也有人戏谑推荐其他含相关毒素的植物，或直接表示想购买尝试。

补充讨论：评论还讨论了北卡罗来纳州杜鹃花烟雾可能致泻的民间说法，但具体植物种类和科学依据不明确。

data.title: Evidence of Fraud in an Influential Study About Procrastination
data.author: Anon84
data.article_summary: 文章讨论Ariely与Wertenbroch 2002年拖延研究的复制失败。原研究称分阶段截止日期能提升任务表现；新复制未能重复该结果。作者重新分析原始数据后，认为Study 1和Study 2的数据可能遭到篡改，并公布分析证据。原作者已要求期刊撤稿，相关程序仍在进行。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕丹·艾瑞里（Dan Ariely）研究数据造假争议、科学研究的可重复性危机，以及学术机构和科研激励机制展开讨论。

不同观点：
• [Aurornis]指出，艾瑞里长期卷入研究争议，成名和出版畅销书后才不断被发现数据问题；杜克大学仍与其保持关系，令人难以理解。  
• [ProjectArcturis]认为，杜克在争议持续曝光后仍留用艾瑞里，损害了学校声誉，并联想到其他大学的学术丑闻及 Epstein 关系。  
• [bawolff]认为此类造假门槛过低：涉事研究只需让人校对文本即可复核，却多年无人重复；建议改变科研激励，甚至让本科生随机复现论文。  
• [freediddy]主张论文在被独立团队复现前不应被引用，认为复制危机可能导致公众最终不再相信科学结论。  
• [hnacct2001]关注实际应用层面：若研究削弱了“截止日期有积极作用”的常见认识，那么应如何设计、维持截止日期，或用什么替代。  
• [keyle]以讽刺口吻批评作者似乎承认问题，却没有采取实质行动；[fabiensanglard]则简短指出事件具有讽刺意味。

补充讨论：争议焦点包括研究诚信与机构责任、论文发表和引用前是否应强制复现，以及如何在防止造假的同时维持有效的科研激励。

49516199.article_content:
A new paper in
Psychological Science
(.
htm
) reports a failure to replicate Study 2 of Ariely and Wertenbroch’s influential article entitled, “Procrastination, Deadlines, and Performance: Self-Control by Precommitment.” The original study, published in
Psychological Science
in 2002 (
.htm
), found that people performed better on a set of tasks when each task had its own externally imposed deadline than when people set their own deadlines or faced a single last-day deadline for all tasks. The paper has had a lasting influence. It has been assigned reading in many economics and psychology courses, and has more than 2,100 citations on Google Scholar.
Because this paper has been so influential, it is worthwhile to take a close look at the original study to try to understand why it did not replicate. We did that. This post – and the next one – is about what we found.
***
About 20 years ago, on April 20, 2006, one of the authors of the forthcoming replication, Kyle Hyndman, received the original data files in an email sent from
[email protected]
[
1
]. And about 3 years ago, on August 9, 2023, a week after Francesca Gino sued us for $25 million,  we received an out-of-the-blue email from Hyndman in which he sent those files to us. We performed quick analyses of the data, and then had a conversation with Hyndman and his co-author, Alberto Bisin. In that conversation, they told us they were going to conduct a replication, and, finding ourselves busy with the lawsuit, we left it at that.
We recently learned that their replication was forthcoming in
Psychological Science
. And upon reading Footnote 14 of their paper, we also learned this:
. . .
In October 2024, at the request of the editors, we shared with Dan Ariely an analysis of the contents from the file purportedly for their Study 2 and asked for permission to include a summary of it in the paper. Dan Ariely denied our request, arguing, among other things, that the files we received may not be the actual data. He did not subsequently provide us with any additional data from the original paper. Consequently, we are unable to supplement our replication exercise with any additional analysis of the files we received in 2006 or any other data.
This motivated us to return to this paper and fully analyze the original data for the two main studies. We conclude that the data in Studies 1 and 2 were tampered with. In two posts, we present the evidence that led us to this conclusion. Today’s post focuses on the study that failed to replicate (Study 2), and our next post is about Study 1.
Our assessment that the data were tampered with are based entirely on the analyses presented in our posts. Readers can review the evidence and draw their own conclusions.
To the best of our knowledge, Klaus Wertenbroch has never had access to any version of the data for any of the studies. And, we believe it is thanks to him that we do. When Kyle Hyndman reached out to the authors back in 2006, Klaus replied with this email [
2
]:
Our
ResearchBox
contains the data and code to reproduce all of the results in this post.
Finally, it should be noted that when we shared these posts with Ariely and Wertenbroch a few weeks ago, they reached out to
Psychological Science
to request that the article be retracted. As of this writing, that process is ongoing.
The Study That Did Not Replicate: Study 2 of Ariely and Wertenbroch (2002)
As noted above, Ariely and Wertenbroch explored how deadlines influence performance. In a context in which people had multiple tasks to perform, the authors hypothesized that people would perform better in the face of evenly spaced deadlines for those tasks, rather than when they were all due at the end.
The experiment involved an incentivized proofreading task. Each participant received three 10-page documents, each containing 100 “grammatical and spelling errors” (p. 222). Participants were tasked with finding and correcting those errors.
Sixty participants were randomly assigned to one of three conditions, exactly 20 participants in each condition:
Condition 1. Evenly Spaced Deadlines.
One document was due each week, so after 7, 14, and 21 days.
Condition 2. Set Your Own Deadlines.
Participants chose their own deadlines (within 21 days).
Condition 3. Last Day Deadline.
All three documents were due on the final (21
st
) day.
The results perfectly and strongly supported the authors’ hypothesis. Participants given evenly spaced deadlines did much better, in terms of performance, delays, and earnings [
3
].
Do We Have The Original Data?
As a reminder, in 2023 Hyndman sent us files he received from
[email protected]
in 2006. There were three Excel files – data for a pilot study, for Study 1, and for Study 2 – all with file properties indicating that the data were “Last saved by” “Dan Ariely”.
With these files we are able to reproduce all nine means and all nine standard errors shown in the figure above, as shown visually in this footnote: [

]. We also successfully reprodu

data.title: Run macOS Software on Linux
data.author: Bluestein
data.article_summary: Darling 是一个开源、免费的 Linux macOS 兼容层，类似 Wine，可直接运行部分 macOS 软件，无需硬件模拟器。它基于 Darwin，提供 Mach、dyld、launchd 等环境，并已实验性支持简单图形应用。项目遵循 GPLv3，不违反苹果许可协议，未来计划支持 iOS 应用，欢迎社区贡献。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Darling及相关项目能否在Linux上运行macOS软件，以及其技术基础、兼容范围和实际价值。

不同观点：
• 项目基础派：Darling基于Apple公开的Darwin源码，并结合Cocotron、Apportable Foundation、GNUstep等实现Cocoa，具有较扎实的开源基础。
• 技术探索派：有人尝试通过替换系统调用、设置陷阱等方式，让Linux程序在macOS上运行，虽受ARM64寄存器x18的平台保留限制，仍已能编译VPP及依赖。
• 谨慎乐观派：在ARM64 Linux运行Apple Silicon应用很有吸引力，但当前性能和功能远不完整；Darling主要支持x86_64，项目更新也较少。
• 实用需求派：用户希望运行Logic、Final Cut Pro、Xcode构建工具等，以避免购买昂贵Mac；但GUI支持仍处于实验阶段，Logic、Xcode等复杂软件尚不能运行。
• 需求怀疑派：部分人认为缺少真正想使用的Mac独占软件；Photoshop等软件日益臃肿，即使官方支持Linux也未必会使用。
• 兼容性澄清派：Darling可运行基于开源Darwin的程序，但依赖macOS专有框架的软件无法运行。

补充讨论：争议焦点在于“能运行命令行工具”与“完整支持商业GUI应用”之间的巨大差距；此外，App Store下载、DRM及法律限制也可能阻碍实际使用。

uname
Darwin
Darling
Darling is a translation layer that lets you run macOS software on Linux
Fast
Darling runs macOS software directly without using a hardware emulator.
Free
Like Linux, Darling is free and open-source software.
It is developed openly on GitHub and distributed under the GNU GPL license version 3.
Compatible
Darling implements a complete Darwin environment. Mach, dyld, launchd â everything you'd expect.
Easy to use
Darling does most of the setup for you. Sit back and enjoy using your favorite software.
Native
We aim to fully integrate apps running under Darling into the Linux desktop experience by making them look, feel and behave just like native Linux apps.
That sounds a lot like
Wine
And it is! Wine lets you run Windows software on Linux, and Darling does the same for macOS software.
Does it support GUI apps?
Almost! This took us a lot of time and effort, but we finally have basic experimental support for running
simple
graphical applications.
Does it violate Apple's EULA?
No! We only directly use those parts of Darwin that are released as fully free software.
Does the name Darling mean anything?
The name Darling is a combination of âDarwinâ and âLinuxâ. Darwin is the core operating system macOS and iOS are based on.
Can I run Darling on Windows using WSL?
With WSL 2, yes! See
the documentation
for more details.
Do you know about
opensource.apple.com
, GNUstep, The Cocotron and other projects?
We do, and in fact, Darling is largely based on the original Darwin source code published by Apple. We use The Cocotron as a basis for our Cocoa implementation, along with the
Apportable Foundation
and various bits of GNUstep.
Do you have plans for supporting iOS apps?
Yes, in the long run, we'd like to be able to run iOS apps on ARM devices (like most Android phones). A significant challenge here would be to write our own implementation of UIKit. Come talk to us if you're interested in working on this!
How do I contribute?
Start by reading the
documentation
and
our blog
to get familiar with Darling internals. Then, come and join us
on GitHub
. It's great if you have experience in developing for macOS or iOS, but it's absolutely not required to start contributing.

data.author: keithcarolus
data.article_summary: 请提供文章正文、标题或链接。目前提供的内容只是网页页脚信息，无法判断文章主题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕单HTML文件实现的ASCII风格3D城市游戏，评论集中于技术表现、体验可得性、艺术边界及项目展示方式。

不同观点：
• 技术赞赏：多人认为作品视觉惊艳，能在浏览器单文件中实现ASCII艺术、3D渲染和行走机制，体现了浏览器技术潜力；也有人联想到MUD、DOS文字冒险、textmode demo及《索尼克》关卡的复古风格。
• 浏览器优先：aley​an认为固定宽度字符艺术应优先在浏览器开发，因为字体、比例、鼠标输入、性能分析和最终呈现更可控，优于终端TUI。
• 艺术性疑问：kodoman担心画面越逼真，越会失去ASCII艺术特征；mattgoupil则认为缺少可辨识字母，难以突出“ASCII”属性。另有人提出用实心块、半块和阴影字符优化绘制与抖动效果。
• 体验与版本问题：naet称实际运行效果与视频不同且难以理解；rkagerer发现原型需要付费，且视频中的v2似乎尚未发布；jeffgreco质疑GitHub项目是否与视频版本一致。
• 发布方式批评：Hugsbox和andsoitis找不到所谓HTML页面，质疑为何只发布视频；teddyh进一步认为这是为基础3D渲染原型收费的广告。

补充讨论：争议焦点是作品是否真正开放可体验、展示版本是否一致，以及其商业化和宣传方式是否透明。

data.title: Lion-man – the oldest confirmed statue ever discovered
data.author: gurjeet
data.article_summary: “狮人”是1939年在德国霍伦施泰因-施塔德尔洞穴发现的史前雕像，由猛犸象牙雕刻而成，年代约3.5万至4.1万年前，属于奥瑞纳文化。雕像融合人身与洞狮头部，是已知最早的艺术作品和雕像之一。经多次修复后，高31.1厘米，现藏于乌尔姆博物馆。其性别及象征意义至今仍有争议。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕“狮人”雕像的年代、原型、制作方式及其在早期人类认知与社会中的意义展开讨论。

不同观点：
• 年代与地域：多数讨论将其定位为约3.5万至4.1万年前的德国遗物；另有评论者提到自己接触过约公元前9000年、叙利亚地区的类似泥塑，并认为其年代相对晚得多。  
• 动物原型：有人认为雕像以欧亚洞狮为直接原型。洞狮体型约比现代非洲狮大20%，且雄性可能没有明显鬃毛，洞穴壁画可作为依据。  
• 认知与宗教意义：有观点将其视为“认知革命”的早期证据，说明人类能够想象现实中不存在的生物，并通过艺术共享故事，甚至可能与宗教起源有关。  
• 制作与劳动分工：针对“生存压力下为何有人专门雕刻”的疑问，有人推测制作者可能是老人、伤者、年轻人或萨满，反映出早期社会或许已存在角色分工。

补充讨论：有人以未来人类误读电脑遗物的玩笑，讽刺考古解释的不确定性；最后一条询问是否出售且有原包装，与主题无关。

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
Prehistoric ivory sculpture discovered in the Hohlenstein-Stadel, a cave in Germany
This article is about the prehistoric sculpture. For other uses, see
Lion man
.
Löwenmensch (Lion-man)
Material
Mammoth ivory
Created
c. 40,000 years ago
Discovered
25 August 1939
Asselfingen
,
Baden-Wurttemberg
,
Germany
Discovered by
Otto Völzing
Present location
Museum Ulm
,
Ulm
,
Baden-Wurttemberg
,
Germany
Side view showing the transverse gouges on the left arm
The
Löwenmensch
figurine
, also called the
Lion-man of
Hohlenstein-Stadel
, is a prehistoric
sculpture
discovered in
Hohlenstein-Stadel
, a German cave, part of the
Caves and Ice Age Art in the Swabian Jura
UNESCO
World Heritage Site
, in 1939. The German name,
Löwenmensch
, meaning "lion-person" or "lion-human", is used most frequently because it was discovered and is exhibited in Germany. It is an anthropomorphic figurine combining a human-like body with the head of a
cave lion
(
Panthera spelaea
).
Determined by
carbon dating
of the layer in which it was found to be between 35,000 and 41,000 years old, it is one of the oldest-known examples of an
artistic representation
and the oldest confirmed statue ever discovered.
[
1
]
Its age associates it with the archaeological
Aurignacian
culture of the
Upper Paleolithic
.
[
2
]
An example of
zoomorphic
art, it was carved out of
mammoth
ivory
using a
flint
stone knife. Seven parallel, transverse, carved gouges are on the left arm.
After several reconstructions that have incorporated newly found fragments, the figurine stands
31.1
cm (12.2
in)
tall,
5.6
cm (2.2
in)
wide, and
5.9
cm (2.3
in)
thick. It is currently displayed in the
Museum Ulm
, in the city of
Ulm
.
History
[
edit
]
Systematic excavations at
Hohlenstein-Stadel
cave began in 1937 under the direction of historian
Robert Wetzel
[
de
]
.
[
3
]
The discovery of a fragmented
mammoth
ivory
figurine was made on 25
August 1939 by geologist
Otto Völzing
[
de
]
.
[
4
]
The start of
World War II
just one week later meant that the
fieldwork
was left incomplete and analysis of the finds was not undertaken. The excavation trenches were back-filled with the same soil in which the ivory had been found.
[
5
]
For approximately thirty years, the fragments lay forgotten at the nearby
Museum Ulm
. It was not until archaeologist
Joachim Hahn
started an inventory and assembly of more than 200
fragments that a figurine with animal and human features began to emerge.
[
5
]
Wetzel continued to spend summers digging at the site until 1961,
[
6
]
and further finds of ivory were made on the cave floor in the 1970s. In 1982, paleontologist
Elisabeth Schmid
combined the new fragments with Hahn's reconstruction, correcting some errors and adding pieces of the nose and mouth which emphasized the figurine's feline characteristics.
[
5
]
[
a
]
In 1987, a comprehensive restoration began in the workshops of the
Landesmuseum Württemberg
by Ute Wolf in cooperation with Schmid. During the work, which took more than six months, it was realized that the figurine was only about two-thirds complete. The back was severely damaged and the legs were missing some ivory
lamellae
. The ears, eye-holes, two-thirds of the mouth and nose, and the back of the head were preserved. To fill gaps in the head and body, a reversible substance consisting of a mixture of beeswax, artificial wax, and chalk was used.
[
9
]
In 2008, further excavations were carried out in the cave. All layers were sifted systematically, which led to many minute fragments being discovered. The first new adjustments were simulated virtually so that fragments could be added without having to disassemble the original recreation.
[
10
]
[
b
]
In 2012, a second restoration was begun in the workshops of the State Office for the Preservation of Historical Monuments in Esslingen under the leadership of
Nicole Ebinger-Rist
. The figurine was disassembled into its individual parts and newly discovered fragments were added along with the old ones, allowing further completion of areas of the head, back, and right side of the body, and artificial additions used during the first restoration were discarded.
[
12
]
The
Löwenmensch
figurine grew in height from 296 to 311
millimetres.
[
13
]
Work was completed in late 2013.
[
12
]
Interpretation
[
edit
]
Some researchers have ascribed sexual characteristics to the object. Initially, the figurine was classified as male by Hahn who suggested a plate on the abdomen could be a flaccid penis. Schmid later classified this feature as a pubic triangle;
[
4
]
however, from examination of new parts of the sculpture, she proposed that the figurine was that of a woman with the head of a female cave lion.
[
14
]
[
15

49494181.article_summary: “狮人”是1939年在德国霍伦施泰因-施塔德尔洞穴发现的史前雕像，由猛犸象牙雕刻而成，年代约3.5万至4.1万年前，属于奥瑞纳文化。雕像融合人身与洞狮头部，是已知最早的艺术作品和雕像之一。经多次修复后，高31.1厘米，现藏于乌尔姆博物馆。其性别及象征意义至今仍有争议。
49494181.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕“狮人”雕像的年代、原型、制作方式及其在早期人类认知与社会中的意义展开讨论。

不同观点：
• 年代与地域：多数讨论将其定位为约3.5万至4.1万年前的德国遗物；另有评论者提到自己接触过约公元前9000年、叙利亚地区的类似泥塑，并认为其年代相对晚得多。  
• 动物原型：有人认为雕像以欧亚洞狮为直接原型。洞狮体型约比现代非洲狮大20%，且雄性可能没有明显鬃毛，洞穴壁画可作为依据。  
• 认知与宗教意义：有观点将其视为“认知革命”的早期证据，说明人类能够想象现实中不存在的生物，并通过艺术共享故事，甚至可能与宗教起源有关。  
• 制作与劳动分工：针对“生存压力下为何有人专门雕刻”的疑问，有人推测制作者可能是老人、伤者、年轻人或萨满，反映出早期社会或许已存在角色分工。

data.title: Carmack: Has early Scratch experience led to fulfilling careers?
data.author: ilamont
data.article_summary: 约翰·卡马克质疑Scratch作为儿童编程入门工具的实际长期价值。他表示，自己从未听说有人将成功职业生涯归功于早期学习Scratch，反而常听到游戏改模带来职业发展的案例，因此向网友征集相关成功故事。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Scratch及早期编程经历是否会成为进入计算机领域的契机，以及儿童编程教育的长期影响。

不同观点：
• “催化剂未必是最初接触”：有人13岁就学过C++，但真正记忆深刻、促成职业选择的是编写《RuneScape》脚本；早期接触可能只是基础，兴趣和成就感才是关键。
• “Scratch能激发长期兴趣”：有人认为Scratch直接引导自己进入计算机职业，曾用它制作游戏、操作系统、动画和模拟项目；早期社区的鼓励、分享和协作也很重要。
• “Scratch的问题在于生态断层”：Scratch适合键盘基础薄弱的儿童，但孩子成长很快，掌握基础后容易进入缺乏进阶路径和内容的“沙漠”，生态衔接不足。
• “工具不同但结果相近”：有人从低配BASIC起步，后来从事嵌入式和数据库架构；其孩子从Scratch、Minecraft发展到参数化CAD和航天相关设计，说明起点工具并不决定最终方向。

补充讨论：评论整体认可早期动手实践的价值，但争议焦点在于：Scratch本身是否是职业启蒙的决定性因素，还是兴趣、社区支持及后续学习路径共同发挥作用。

data.title: Terence Tao explains 6 essential mathematical concepts [video]
data.author: matthewsinclair
data.article_summary: 请提供文章正文或链接。目前提供的内容只是网站页脚信息，无法概括文章主要内容。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕陶哲轩（Terence Tao）数学科普演讲的清晰度、数学核心领域及其对数学研究和人工智能的启发。

不同观点：
• 赞赏其表达能力：多位评论者认为他能深入浅出地解释复杂概念，令人产生“自己也能理解高等数学”的信心；傅里叶变换等例子被认为极具启发性。  
• 数学领域的取舍：演讲列出“数、代数、几何、概率、分析、动力学”，有人建议将几何替换为拓扑，并补充逻辑、类型论；也有人认为这只是对数学研究的“降维概括”。  
• 关注数学思维本质：评论者希望进一步了解数学推理的基本要素，如归纳与演绎、抽象、证明及数学家的思维过程。  
• 认同数学研究价值：有人特别认可其关于数学研究目的、学术传统重要性，以及数学方法对理解人工智能影响的意义。  
• 质疑“猴子写《哈姆雷特》”的比喻：认为将其视为暴力搜索、并用“二次时间”描述学习过程，过度简化且低估了问题的非线性；原评论者后来推测这可能涉及进化过程。

补充讨论：评论推荐了相关数学书籍、陶哲轩其他演讲及分析学中的黎曼重排定理；另有人讨论“无理数”一词的词源可能是玩笑，也有拼写纠正和误把姓名看成 Terrence Howard 的插曲。

data.title: Show HN: Laser Graffiti
data.author: con
data.article_summary: 这是一款基于浏览器的激光涂鸦互动工具。通过投影仪和摄像头校准，将激光点实时映射到投影画面，用户可绘画、使用多种笔刷和特效、玩井字棋、保存快照，并通过激光操作菜单。无需安装，支持红/绿激光，开源且依赖少。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：利用投影仪、摄像头和激光笔实现临时“激光涂鸦”的创意项目，以及其艺术性、技术实现和潜在应用。

不同观点：
• 支持与怀旧：多数评论认为项目有趣、酷，唤起童年玩激光笔、Arduino控制器或早期黑客空间项目的记忆；有人分享了整栋建筑投影、儿童博物馆影像装置等类似案例。  
• 创作者立场：作者说明项目源自Graffiti Research Lab及维也纳黑客空间，目标是将旧版Mac应用改造成网页应用；强调只需投影仪、激光笔、笔记本和摄像头，且支持手机摄像头、AirPlay等灵活组合。  
• 艺术形式争议：Vakaiser认为当前更像“激光展示”而非真正的涂鸦，主张用激光雕刻器把图案刻入砖墙或金属表面；其他人则倾向于临时、非破坏性的户外展示。  
• 技术改进建议：关注不规则表面的投影对齐、线条“滴落”效果、荧光或半透明颜料的视觉匹配，以及从下往上绘制以改善流畅度。  
• 应用与玩味：有人设想用于建筑、户外临时显示或街头装置，也有人提出与猫追逐激光点结合的幽默玩法。

补充讨论：核心争议是永久性破坏与安全风险（人体伤害、火灾、能耗）和“规则很酷”的创作冲动之间的取舍。

49489376.article_content:
Try it right here
No projector needed for this one — your mouse (or finger) is the laser. Pick a brush, flip on a mode, or play tic-tac-toe against the computer by drawing an X in a cell.
How it works
Everything runs in the browser — no install, no native app.
01
Set up
Connect a projector as a second screen and point a webcam at the projected area. Open the control window and the projector window (press
F
for fullscreen).
02
Calibrate
One click flashes markers into the corners of the projection; the camera finds them and computes the camera→projector mapping. Then wave the laser for 4 seconds so the detector learns its brightness and colour.
03
Draw
Every frame the camera finds the laser dot, maps it onto the projector, and the projector renders the stroke — right where you pointed. Hold the laser in the ☰ corner to open an on-wall menu.
Features
Six brushes: round, marker, calligraphy, neon, spray, rainbow
Wet ink that drips down the wall
Spin your drawing as an extruded 3D object
Fade-out mode and kaleidoscope mirroring
Sparkle particle trail
Tic-tac-toe against the computer, on the wall
Coloured border around the drawable area
Snapshots: save photo + drawing, download as files
Laser-operated menu — no need to touch the laptop
Reflection-robust tracking for shiny floors
Works with green or red lasers
Zero dependencies, MIT-licensed,
open source
What you need
A laptop with Chrome, a projector (any HDMI projector works — it's just a second screen), a webcam that can see the projected area (the built-in one is fine), and a laser pointer. Green shows up best on camera.
Start Laser Graffiti →

data.title: Dwarf Fortress is getting the mother of all magic updates
data.author: Tomte
data.article_summary: 《矮人要塞》将于今年晚些时候推出“神话与魔法”更新。该更新会在世界生成时构建独特的魔法体系，涵盖魔法材料、附魔、仪式、遗迹及法术等，并与宇宙运行规则深度关联。玩家可通过要塞研究发现魔法，体验现有系统难以实现的奇异事件与玩法。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕《矮人要塞》的长期开发、魔法系统更新、程序生成机制，以及Steam版本带来的影响展开讨论。

不同观点：
• 长期支持与高度认可：许多评论称赞Tarn和Zach坚持开发，认为Steam发行和更友好的界面让游戏吸引了新玩家；有人投入数千至上万小时，甚至购买多人授权，并将游戏视为工程兴趣的启蒙。  
• 对键盘界面变更的不满：有长期资助者认为新鼠标界面削弱了原有键盘操作，像是忽视老玩家；虽然后来开发者收回部分决定，但争议仍在。  
• 对程序生成魔法的期待：评论者期待魔法由神祇、影响领域、职业和工坊等系统生成，甚至认为这是随机化世界基本规则，而非单纯生成地图；也有人担心最终会趋同。  
• 对开发进度的不同理解：有人期待已久并认为魔法即将到来，但也有评论指出当前工作更像底层重构，完整魔法机制可能还要数个更新。  
• 怀旧与社区文化：Boatmurdered等经典故事、早期版本经历和开发播客唤起强烈怀旧情绪。

补充讨论：有人调侃免费长期开发对创作者的启示，也有人提出用现代AI和3D界面包装DF核心引擎的设想。

49467636.article_content:
If you click on a link and make a purchase we may receive a small commission.
Read our editorial policy
.
Infamously simulation-heavy colony builder
Dwarf Fortress
is getting a Myth and Magic update that, at the possible risk of being maybe a touch hyperbolic, threatens to make all other fantasy game spellcraft look like a sleepy bout of Got Your Nose. It's summarised by Bay12 co-founder Tarn Adams as a set of procedural systems "that go beyond combining spell effects... straight to the fundamental cosmological makeup of the universe", allowing for "magical situations that you cannot get any other way."
So many dwarves are going to die, aren't they, Tarn? And in such exotic and unexpected ways. Here's a brief video announcing the update, which is coming later this year.
Dwarf Fortress Myth and Magic Update Preview - Official Trailer
Watch on YouTube
If I'm reading the tea leaves correctly, the update will generate a variety of approaches to sorcery in the course of regular world generation. Distinct species of wizardry and witchcraft will arise with tectonic abandon in the course of laying down rivers and mountains, and charting the fates of creatures, populations and settlements. It certainly sounds like a big bounce beyond the existing
relatively threadbare magic system
.
As Adams goes on, this will allow "your fortresses to pursue magical research that really feels like discovery", encompassing "magic materials, enchantments, rituals, and ruins" together with spells that just "blow things up". You can see a few examples in the video, including a goblin-shredding hex that doubles as a means of shifting stone. All of it tied into "how that particular universe works down to its bones", Adams promises.
They've been working on the feature for many years. I probably don't need to remind you Rock Paper Magma Shotgunners that Dwarf Fortress is pretty intense and elaborate even without any procgen thaumaturgy. If you do need reminding, here's Nate's old
Basement of Curiosity series
. Please bear in mind that the first entry was written in 2019, long before the launch of the Steam edition with its more approachable artstyle – the game has grown horrifyingly since then. In 2023, Sin also
had thoughts
on why none of Dwarf Fortress's many imitators or fellow travellers have managed to eclipse it.

• 对程序生成魔法的期待：评论者期待魔法由神祇、影响领域、职业和工坊等系统生成，甚至认为这是随机化世界基本规则，而非单纯生成地图；也有人担心最终会趋同。  
• 对开发进度的不同理解：有人期待已久并认为魔法即将到来，但也有评论指出当前工作更像底层重构，完整魔法机制可能还要数个更新。  
• 怀旧与社区文化：Boatmurdered等经典故事、早期版本经历和开发播客唤起强烈怀旧情绪。

data.title: Google Has Removed MV2 Extensions from the Chrome Web Store, Including UBO
data.author: twapi
data.article_summary: Google已完成Chrome扩展Manifest V2迁移，Chrome应用商店移除所有MV2扩展，包括知名广告拦截器uBlock Origin。已安装的MV2扩展仍可使用，但无法更新或重新安装。此举也影响依赖该商店的其他Chromium浏览器。Brave将自行托管AdGuard、uBlock Origin、uMatrix和NoScript，以继续支持部分MV2扩展。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕 Chromium 逐步限制广告拦截功能，评论者讨论网络安全、浏览器选择、用户控制权及 Firefox 的发展问题。

不同观点：
• 安全优先：广告拦截已成为防诈骗和恶意软件的重要防线，尤其能保护不熟悉技术的家人。Google、微软未能有效过滤恶意广告，因此建议直接为家人安装 Firefox、uBlock Origin 等工具。
• 反对 Google 控制：Chrome 背后的 Google 不应拥有过大的互联网和信息控制权。部分人因 Google 封禁账号、申诉全自动等经历，强调不要过度依赖 Google 生态。
• 支持转向 Firefox：许多评论认为 Firefox 已足够好，配合 uBlock Origin 可顺畅浏览，YouTube 等网站对其反广告拦截力度较低；也有人推荐 Zen、LibreWolf、Floorp 等分支。
• 对 Firefox 的矛盾态度：一方面认为它是当前少数独立、安全的主流选择，另一方面批评 Mozilla 加入 AI 和第三方整合、性能不够理想，希望其回归轻量高效，甚至接受付费模式。
• 过渡性方案：uBlock Origin Lite 作为 MV3 扩展虽不如原版，但仍能满足基本需求；Ladybird 被视为未来可能出现的新竞争者。

补充讨论：争议焦点在于广告商业模式与用户安全、隐私和自主控制之间的冲突，以及 Firefox 能否承担制衡 Chromium 的角色。

49514878.article_content:
Google today reached the
final milestone
in a browser-extension transition that has been years in the making, all remaining Manifest V2 extensions were removed from the Chrome Web Store. Among them is uBlock Origin, one of the most capable and widely respected content blockers ever built for the web.
Google also noted that, “Manifest V2 extensions installed on Chrome 138 or earlier will remain installed, but will be unable to receive any updates and cannot be reinstalled from the Chrome Web Store once removed from Chrome.”.
Moreover, Chrome Web Store (CWS) team has informed the affected extension developers regarding this removal action.
Removal Affects More Than Google Chrome
It is important to note that the Chrome Web Store is the dominant extension marketplace for Chromium-based browsers. Users of non-Chrome Chromium browsers, including Brave, also rely on the CWS to discover and install extensions.
As a result, the removal has consequences beyond Google Chrome. Users can no longer find or install these Manifest V2 extensions through the Chrome Web Store, even if the Chromium-based browser they use continues to support Manifest V2.
Brave Keeps Select Manifest V2 Extensions Alive
Brave browser team
has decided
to host four popular MV2 extensions on its own backend, and let users easily enable them in their browser installation. These extensions are AdGuard, uBlock Origin, uMatrix, and NoScript.
Google’s argument for Manifest V3 is straightforward. The company says the newer extension platform, MV3, provides stronger security, privacy, performance, and tighter control over what extensions are allowed to do. Considering how much access browser extensions can have to a user’s browsing activity, those are legitimate problems to solve.

data.title: Smartphone LED detects hidden cameras with AI
data.author: geox
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：利用手机LED/激光扫描和反射分析检测住宿场所的隐藏摄像头，讨论其可靠性、适用范围及可能的反制手段。

不同观点：
• 支持实用性：认为利用手机通知灯或闪光灯扫描镜头很巧妙，可能成为旅行工具；若普及，还能形成对安装偷拍设备的威慑。  
• 质疑检测效果：小孔镜头、特殊角度、布料或遮挡物后的摄像头可能避开扫描；有人认为热成像更稳妥，可发现摄像头、无线发射器和芯片的热量。  
• 认为需多方法结合：除光学反射外，还可通过制造运动、检测传输突增等方式识别设备，但缓存、突发传输和恒定码率也能规避，因此应建立综合评分或多技术检测方案。  
• 讨论技术改进：红外扫描可避免可见光干扰；镜头壁纸、无镜头传感器、压缩感知和远距离观察可能削弱或规避检测。AI是否真正学习，还是仅进行复杂反射分析，也受到怀疑。  
• 反制升级观点：有人担心摄像头可延迟启动，避开检测；更激进的设想是用多波长高功率激光扫描并烧毁设备，但这涉及安全和误伤风险。  
• 需求程度之争：有人质疑普通住客是否有必要担心酒店偷拍，也有人表示会立即在Airbnb或酒店使用。

补充讨论：争议焦点在于光学扫描能否覆盖微型、隐蔽、特殊材质或延迟启动的摄像头，以及检测便利性与实际可靠性之间的差距。

data.title: Apple caught off guard by AI demand for Mac Mini and Mac Studio
data.author: thm
data.article_summary: 据《The Information》报道，企业对运行大型AI模型的Mac mini和Mac Studio需求意外激增，促使苹果提前发布新机型，并重点宣传多台Mac Studio协同运行AI。苹果此前缺乏企业客户和开发者团队，也没有成熟的企业AI战略，只能依靠合作伙伴提供服务。受需求暴涨及全球内存短缺影响，部分高配机型长期缺货，企业开始转向英伟达等替代产品。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：苹果近期发布 Mac mini、Mac Studio 等产品，是否源于企业对本地 AI 硬件的意外需求，以及苹果能否借此发展本地 AI 生态。

不同观点：
• 质疑营销炒作：nullbio、HDBaseT、imagetic认为消息来自不知名媒体和匿名“消息源”，类似 Mac mini 被宣传为 OpenClaw 设备的案例，疑似苹果操纵舆论；“苹果措手不及”也不可信。
• 认可真实需求：alasdair_指出强化学习、自博弈训练等任务适合本地实验，能省去云端实例部署和传输时间；setgree认为即使大公司也可能意外发现产品市场契合点。
• 看好本地 AI 潜力：Danox、bilsbie、Xeoncross认为苹果硬件适合本地模型，经济型 32GB Mac 可能成为运行开放权重模型的平台，但苹果似乎更重视 AI 宣传而非实际支持。
• 持保留态度：Grombobulous认为本地体验远逊于每月20美元的云服务；saejox担心模型循环、内存短缺，建议暂用云端。
• 其他立场：Mac mini此前也是实用的HTPC，AI热潮推高了需求；Neo缺货可能受学生市场欢迎；有人期待苹果改善系统稳定性，并重启 Xserve。

补充讨论：争议焦点是需求究竟真实还是营销制造，以及苹果能否通过软件、集群支持和系统优化兑现本地 AI 潜力。

49508982.article_content:
Apple Caught Off Guard by AI Demand for Mac Mini and Mac Studio
Sunday August 30, 2026 8:52 am PDT
by
Hartley Charlton
Apple's unusually timed announcement of new
Mac mini
and
Mac Studio
models this week was driven by unexpectedly strong enterprise appetite for AI hardware, according to
The Information
.
Apple normally releases new Mac models in the autumn, closer to October or November, making this week's announcement unusually early, falling just before the anticipated arrival of new iPhone models.
The Information
says that the AI-driven boom in ‌Mac Studio‌ and ‌Mac mini‌ sales is behind the early launch.
Apple noticeably
promoted the ability
to link multiple Mac Studios together into a single, more capable system for running large frontier AI models, a feature aimed at business and developer customers rather than everyday consumers.
Apple highlighted the ‌Mac mini‌ and ‌Mac Studio‌'s shift toward business buyers in June, with a "Business at the Park" event involving executives from major companies Ford, Disney, and Anthropic. The ‌Mac mini‌ was said to be the "darling" of the event.
Even so, enterprise's rush toward powerful desktop Macs more broadly took Apple by surprise. The company reportedly did not possess an engineering team dedicated to business customers or staff focused on developer relations, and lacked an enterprise AI strategy.
Businesses that approached Apple asking to buy access to the company's Private Cloud Compute infrastructure were reportedly turned down. Apple is instead leaning on partners such as WebAI and Mount Thor, which provide AI tools and execution environments built on Apple hardware.
A surge in demand for Mac hardware to run AI models has coincided with the global memory shortage, leaving many ‌Mac mini‌ and ‌Mac Studio‌ configurations out of stock for months. Some enterprise customers are reportedly turning to other hardware such as Nvidia's DGX Spark, a compact AI desktop launched late last year in a form factor similar to the ‌Mac mini‌'s, as Apple's own high end configurations remain difficult to get hold of.

As the
Judo World Championship
draws near this June in Budapest, it feels like the perfect time to bring together my passion for Judo (and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu) with my gusto for complex network analyses — a fusion that’s been a long time in the making! While my posts typically focus on biodiversity-related topics and statistical modeling, I’ve long considered sharing some thoughts on one of my most cherished interests: Judo. This martial art, with its
rich history
and intricate techniques, has fascinated me since my childhood. Judo, which means the
gentle way
in Japanese, is at its competitive heart a dynamic “chess match” of throws, holds, submission techniques, and strategic combinations. While
individual techniques (called
waza
)
are foundational, the real artistry lies in how they are chained together — through
renraku-waza
(combination techniques) and
renzoku-waza
(continuous combination techniques). Thus, in a Judo match, these individual techniques usually unfold as sequences of moves, often building toward a decisive action that is likely to result in a score.
But how can we objectively analyze which attack combinations work best together? Which techniques serve as crucial setups, and which are reliable “killer moves”? This is where network analysis can offer us some insights.
In this post, we’ll explore how to model combinations of Judo throwing techniques as a network using R, trying to uncover hidden patterns in attacking strategies. So, what we will be doing is treating each individual throwing technique as a
node
in a network, with an
edge
(or link) connecting two nodes when one technique naturally sets up or transitions into another as part of an attack sequence. In our Judo attack combination network we should be able to detect: i) which techniques are most frequently used to initiate successful combinations; ii) which techniques are common finishers, “killer moves”; iii) which techniques are most “influential” —or important— in the overall strategic attacking system?
It is important to note that, this post is not intended as a comprehensive review of judo attack combinations; rather, it draws from some classic literature (Kashiwazaki and Nakanishi 1995, Kawaishi 1963, van Haesendonck 1968). I will focus exclusively on two-move attack sequences using only techniques currently recognized by the
Kodokan

data.title: Cheap GPS jammers are filling the world with navigation dead zones
data.author: vinnyglennon
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：GPS/GNSS遭遇干扰或欺骗时，航空、无人机及日常定位系统如何保持可靠性，以及是否应保留或建设替代导航手段。

不同观点：
• **加强冗余、反对过度依赖GPS**：bronco21016认为，VOR等地面导航设施因节约成本逐步退役削弱了航空备份体系；关键系统不应只依赖GPS。teeray提到重启LORAN作为替代方案。  
• **传统设备仍能应急**：giantg2认为地图、指南针、高度计和惯性导航仍可填补GPS精度下降的缺口，不必过度担忧。  
• **采用更先进的抗干扰技术**：stefan_指出民用廉价干扰器通常不足以威胁大型航空，但航空器可部署8阵元CRPA等抗干扰接收机；noipv4认为未来“智能接收机”将取代容易受攻击的普通接收机。  
• **多信号、多来源定位**：United857关注多星座GNSS能否抵御全面干扰；mlhpdx建议利用Wi-Fi、蓝牙及其他电磁发射源的特征和位置数据库辅助定位，尤其适合城市环境。  
• **干扰已影响民用设备并可能扩大**：rkeswick称无人机在商业区附近偶尔失联；jayshah5696认为随着社会依赖GPS，干扰器会像军事领域一样扩散，并波及Starlink等系统。  
• **非技术性诉求**：Descon和donohoe希望用蓝牙干扰器制止公共场所外放音乐，体现了对便携式干扰设备的日常需求。

补充讨论：争议焦点在于GPS干扰的实际威胁程度，以及应优先恢复地面备份、依靠惯性/传统导航，还是投资抗干扰接收机和多源定位。另有观点质疑SandboxAQ等量子传感公司的技术与商业可信度。

data.title: Develop Cross-Platform CLI and GUI Tools with Tcl/Tk
data.author: aryonoco
data.article_summary: 文章全面介绍了Tcl/Tk这一历史悠久、免费开源的跨平台工具包。内容涵盖Tcl语法、字符串模型、命名空间、协程、线程、面向对象、Tk原生GUI、Web开发、独立应用打包及实际案例，并讨论其高效、轻量、灵活等优势，以及生态、IDE、垃圾回收、语法易误用等局限，旨在帮助读者客观认识并入门Tcl/Tk。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Tcl/Tk 的跨平台 GUI 能力、外观与体积，以及 Tcl 语言本身是否值得使用。

不同观点：
• 支持者认为 Tk 简洁实用、跨平台性强。Scheme、Python/Tkinter、Ruby 等都能使用，适合快速构建 Linux、BSD、macOS 和 Windows 上的桌面工具；`wish` 也可快速制作简单界面。  
• 部分评论者认可 Tk，却不喜欢 Tcl，认为 Tcl 语法和语言特性存在问题，更愿意使用 Python、Go 等语言配合 Tk；争议在于其他语言的 Tk 绑定是否足够完善。  
• 有人反驳“界面原生”的说法，认为 Tk 应用外观停留在 2003 年左右，并不像现代 Windows、Linux 或 macOS 原生应用。  
• 有人质疑约 100 MB 的占用，认为与 fasm、tcc、Rebol 等约 1 MB 的工具相比仍然过大。  
• 另有例子表明 Tcl 仍具现实用途，例如 macOS 十六进制编辑器 Hex Fiend 使用 Tcl 作为模板语言。

补充讨论：评论整体区分了 Tcl 语言与 Tk GUI：即使不喜欢 Tcl，也可能认可 Tk；讨论焦点从“能否跨平台”延伸到界面现代性、运行体积和语言生态。

49515662.article_content:
What if I told you there exists a language, or a whole toolkit that:
Can be used to create cross-platform Console and GUI tools or apps
Those GUI apps look native on Windows, Linux and macOS
Supports safe and efficient threading, non-blocking events and I/O
Has a small footprint of about 100MB with most common packages installed
Can produce very compact single-file apps for any supported platform
Is capable of building robust cross-platform Web Apps
Has existed and been in use by some of the largest corporations for over three decades
Is free and BSD-licensed, so you can do whatever you want with it, or to it
Would you believe me?
Foreword
Documenting personal experiences on fascinating or useful topics is what I do.
Real-time visualization
,
3D simulation
,
data safety
,
energy efficiency
, or even
input devices
,
microcontrollers
, and
fitness
— an endless stream of ideas for new studies and exploration is always on the ToDo list.
This particular topic turned up to be quite a bit more involved than I originally planned. But I promise: all information here is what I myself would've loved to have known
before
I started my Tcl/Tk toolkit learning journey.
I'm writing this long after my honeymoon phase with Tcl/Tk ended, and will try to be as objective and honest as possible. Both to you, and to myself. I have nothing to "sell" except my personal experience, hoping to better inform
you
and simplify the "onboarding" process if you ever decide to give Tcl/Tk a try.
Due to its command-centric nature, Tcl is a powerful, yet
widely misunderstood language
. I want to contribute to the conversation, aiming to clear up this persistent confusion with concise explanations and concrete examples. And a bit of flair, of course, to keep you entertained.
Please note:
We’re skipping the "Programming 101" talk here with the assumption that you already have a baseline familiarity with general programming logic. If you know your way around an
if
statement and know what
function
is, you're probably ready to dive straight into Tcl-specific structures and syntax. Think of this article as both a "Tcl hands-up and a primer", in hopes to make you, too, discover and appreciate this almost 40-year old technology that quietly powers the world. And maybe convince you to try it for yourself, and spread the word.
As for the "About the Author" — if you're interested, please visit the
"About" page
.

主要讨论点：美国军方基地冷藏设备同时故障，究竟是网络攻击、软件/配置问题，还是长期维护与系统设计缺陷。

不同观点：
• **网络攻击可能**：CobaltFire认为更可能是错误配置或更新失误，但披露时间与故障巧合令人担忧；mark-r猜测攻击者可能借非机密设备证明已渗透国防网络。Zigurd指出设备在夜间启动除霜、加速升温，且延迟发现，行为可能符合熟悉设备规格的攻击者策略。  
• **技术故障或更新失误**：多人认为统一供应商、共享控制平台、固件缺陷或错误补丁，足以解释多台设备同时异常。PLC从业者指出工业控制设备常缺乏TLS、安全账户配置也很薄弱。  
• **普通维护与管理失误**：codingdave质疑“14台同时故障”的实际意义，认为每天数台设备损坏可能属于正常维护范围；wormius则归因于经费不足、外包和低价维护，类似“麦当劳冰淇淋机”问题。  
• **系统设计不合理**：多位评论者质疑为何冷柜必须联网远程控制，认为复杂、集中化的物联网架构扩大了故障和攻击影响。  
• **影响范围与安全意义**：海外基地若受影响，因物资匮乏、食品价格高，后果可能更严重；Fort Huachuca和F.E. Warren等基地具有重要国防职能，但暂无证据表明机密系统受影响。

补充讨论：作者补充称已有数十起类似故障，但非DeCA控制的店内设备似乎未受影响；评论普遍认为应等待根因分析，争议焦点是“巧合的集中故障”是否足以支持遭到攻击的判断。

data.author: zdw
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：复古计算项目的实际价值与理念边界，重点涉及磁带数据恢复、硬件仿真及大语言模型是否符合复古计算精神。

不同观点：
• ggm关注真实硬件的可用性，希望获得能读取实体磁带（尤其是DAT格式）的磁带机，以便恢复档案数据。若FPGA或小型设备仿真旧设备接口、降低连接SCSI或FireWire磁带机的门槛，将具有直接帮助。  
• ggm指出，若项目只是仿真磁带机的命令集、用于驱动软件中的虚拟磁带设备，则无法读取和恢复旧磁带，解决不了实际需求。专业数据恢复公司虽有能力，但费用高，核心问题是成本效益，而非技术上完全不可行。  
• GalaxyNova认为，大语言模型与复古计算强调的亲手操作、理解底层原理和使用历史硬件的理念相冲突，因此不符合复古计算 ethos。

补充讨论：两条评论关注点不同：ggm讨论的是硬件仿真对真实数据恢复的实用价值，GalaxyNova讨论的是工具选择与复古计算文化之间的价值冲突。潜在争议焦点在于：仿真和现代AI究竟是在降低复古设备的使用门槛，还是削弱了复古计算的核心体验。

data.title: Snakes and Ladders
data.author: surprisetalk
data.article_summary: 文章批评传统“蛇梯棋”缺乏决策、输家过多，提出合作版玩法：玩家共同使用点数为1至6的卡牌决定移动，需让所有棋子到达终点，同时避免踩蛇头或彼此距离过远，否则全队失败。还可加入不同角色及一次性特殊能力，增加策略性与趣味性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：合作桌游如何避免“最优策略”导致一名玩家主导全局、其他玩家失去参与感。

不同观点：
• 对合作桌游持保留态度：评论者认为，许多合作游戏容易变成纯粹的优化问题，少数专注策略的玩家会替全组做决定，导致其他人退出讨论、缺乏参与感。  
• 认可经过改良的合作机制：真正有趣的合作游戏应保留玩家之间的信息不对称或隐藏信息，让每个人都必须独立判断，而非由一名“指挥者”统筹。  
• 例子一：Deadwood 允许玩家在前期以小组合作，但最终通过决斗收束，使合作关系中保留竞争和个人目标。  
• 例子二：Hanabi 中只有其他玩家知道你的手牌，玩家必须通过有限且有策略的信息提示，协作安排出牌顺序，降低单人包办决策的可能。

补充讨论：争议焦点在于，合作桌游应如何平衡团队协作与个人自主性。评论并未否定合作机制，而是主张通过隐藏信息、阶段性竞争等设计，避免“全知玩家”主导游戏。

49449356.article_content:
It is common
1
1
In Sweden, at least.
for promotional pamphlets aimed at
children to contain a themed variant of
snakes and ladders
. This is the “game”
where the players toss a die, move as many places as the die says, and then some
spots on the board have an event that send the player forward, or back, or give
them an extra toss or whatever.
The theme is typically related to whatever the promoter wants to promote, but
styled for children. I get the appeal – for children. They can probably imagine
they’re really travelling along the path! In the variant pictured below, there’s
forest and water and tunnels and dogs and everything!
But as a game, it
sucks
. For everyone. My children hate losing, and these
games have
n
−1 losers for every
n
players. There are also literally zero
decisions for the players to make, so I cannot make it through even a few turns
without zoning out.
Here’s how to make it slightly better. I haven’t analysed this for fairness,
but it’s a good start. And it works for basically any promotional snakes and
ladders board.
Rules for cooperative snakes and ladders
Each player has a pawn, starting at the starting point of the board. If
all
pawns get to the finish, the group has collectively won the game. If any player
Lands on a snake head (a spot with a “bad” event, such as move backwards, skip
a turn, etc.); or
Ends up separated from any other player by more than five
2
2
I haven’t spent
a lot of time tweaking this number, but it should be in the right ballpark.
spots
the group loses. That’s winning and losing.
Movement is not done with a die. Instead, six playing cards (ace to six) are
placed face up on the table. Before a player moves, the team discusses which
card they should use. When a card is selected, that card is flipped back-side up
(to indicate that it has been used) and the player moves that many positions.
The next player then gets to choose a card, with the previously used card
unavailable for selection.
After a short while, one player will get a forced move, because there is only
one face up card remaining. But since the players have discussed which cards to
use in which order, hopefully that forced move is still good! After that move,
all six cards are back-side up, and then they are all turned face up again and
become available for selection for the next player.
This is an easy game. With a typical promotional snakes and ladders board, the
team does not need much foresight to maintain cohesion, avoid snakes, and make
it to the finish. But it still gives a veneer of decision-making to the
participating adult, meaning it is slightly easier to stay engaged than a game
that doesn’t even
pretend
to give the players any choice. And it’s still just
as fun for children, if not more so, because now it’s a goal to stay together!
Optional extension: player roles
I haven’t tested it as much as the previous base game, but here is how the game
can be made easier, yet more varied. At the start, players pick one role each.
The roles come with a special ability, which can be used
once
per game, at any
point during that player’s turn.
The names for these roles are highly provisional.
The
pusher
’s special ability is to move any pawn on the board, rather than
their own. This ability replaces the pusher’s ordinary movement, and thus must
be used before they move.
The
sprinter
’s special ability is to draw an extra movement card after they
have moved. Their moves are executed sequentially, meaning they cannot be
added together to skip over a snake.
The
banker
’s special ability is that they can reset all movement cards to be
face-up after they have moved, giving the next player the ability to choose
between all cards. This ability is activated only
after
the banker has
moved, meaning they cannot use it to increase their own options. When the
banker resets the cards, that cancels any immunity put in place by the
insurer. (See below.)
The
anchor
’s special ability is to skip their turn, meaning they don’t
remove a choice of movement card for the next person, and also don’t get too
far ahead of the rest of the players.
The
cartographer
’s special ability is reusing any already-used (back-side
up) movement card. This card will be used for their ordinary movement, meaning
the ability must be used before they move.
The
duplicator
’s special ability is doubling the value of their movement
card, executed as one move. In other words, this
can
be used to skip over a
snake. This doubling happens as part of their ordinary movement, meaning the
ability must be used before they move.
The
insurer
’s special ability is declaring a snake safe. This immunity
affects all players and lasts from when it is declared until the next time the
movement cards reset. If the insurer uses this ability to survive a forced
move (only one card remaining) the immunity expires immediately after they
have moved (when the movement cards reset). If they use this ability

data.title: Internet centralization and the original sin of NAT
data.author: robinpie
data.article_summary: 文章指出，NAT为缓解IPv4地址短缺而普及，却破坏了互联网端到端直连的初衷，使普通用户难以运行FTP、游戏或网站服务器。端口转发、UPnP、NAT穿透等只能部分解决问题；CGNAT更让用户失去公网端口控制，推动互联网服务进一步集中到云平台。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：NAT是否削弱了互联网的开放性与点对点连接，并推动了客户端—服务器及云端中心化架构。

不同观点：
• RustyRussell认为，NAT为节省IPv4地址而牺牲端口可达性，使用户失去公共端点，削弱了运行服务器和网络平等的能力。  
• solatic认为，NAT确实设置了网络“围墙”，但即使从一开始采用IPv6，普通用户仍会选择Gmail、云服务等更可靠易用的方案，ISP也可能提供默认防火墙，因此中心化或许不可避免。  
• thomastjeffery认为，NAT使中心化成为基础设计，去中心化网络必须依赖昂贵且同样层级化的绕行方案，导致真正拥有发言能力的只有少数富裕者。  
• elric、cm2187、crote等认为，普通NAT本质上也提供防火墙，能保护未打补丁的Windows等不安全设备；端口转发或UPnP并不难，真正问题是用户设备安全性差。CGNAT则明显限制用户自由。  
• miki123211认为，网络犯罪跨地域、难追责，不能照搬现实社会的安全逻辑；NAT通过默认阻断入站连接提供了必要防护。  
• mittensc、g023怀念早期ICQ、文件直传等体验，但也承认当时更易遭攻击且需要技术能力。

补充讨论：争议焦点是NAT究竟是开放互联网衰落的根源，还是对不安全终端的现实防护；IPv6能否恢复直连，也取决于ISP、设备厂商和云服务商的商业利益。

49504905.article_content:
Internet centralization and the original sin of NAT
File Transfer
, Randall Munroe,
https://xkcd.com/949
,
Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 2.5
In this comic, the concept of an ordinary person having an FTP server is quickly dismissed. And yes, itâs not common. To the average computer user, the idea that someone could justâ¦
connect
to your computer feels exotic, or even dangerousâââsee the very common ironic fear of your IP address being known to other people on the internet.
If you take someone whoâs âgood with computersâ but not a networking person, their mental model of The Internet probably involves a definition of âserversâ or âthe cloudâ that distinguishes them from personal computers in some meaningful way. True peerâtoâpeer, if they ever think about it, is an endeavor: WebRTC, STUN, TURN, ICE, what have you. Given that we live in a world of NAT, CGNAT, and restrictive ISPs, this isnât entirely wrong, but it breaks the elegant design of the original Internet.
Why you donât have an FTP server
Network address translation (NAT) was first formally proposed in
RFC 1631
in 1994. In its abstract, it says:
The two most compelling problems facing the IP Internet are IP address depletion and scaling in routing. Longâterm and shortâterm solutions to these problems are being developed. The shortâterm solution is CIDR (Classless InterDomain Routing). The longâterm solutions consist of various proposals for new internet protocols with larger addresses.
Classless interdomain routing is not the point of this post, but basically we started giving people more options for network sizes, and while complex in implementation, it was philosophically virtually uncontroversial.
RFC 1631 proposed a second shortâterm solution to IP address depletion and scaling in routing: NAT. While it is not exactly the same type of NAT omnipresent on home routers today, the basic idea is the same: it allows multiple devices to share an IP address (from the perspective of a device on the other end of a routing device) by modifying the network address information in the IP packet headers while transferring the packet across a traffic routing device. We then later reserved
certain addresses
for private use, and these things are used in conjunction on most IP networksâââprivate addresses within the network, NATing to one public address at the router. On your typical home router, hereâs how you usually connect to an external server with NAT
1
:
Your computer sends a packet like this:
Source IP
10.11.70.21
Source Port
50413
Destination IP
67.215.249.229
Destination Port
70
It hits your router, and it modifies it to this:
Source IP
146.7.15.85
Source Port
60612
Destination IP
67.215.249.229
Destination Port
70
The server replies:
Destination IP
146.7.15.85
Destination Port
60612
Your router rewrites it back:
Destination IP
10.11.70.21
Destination Port
50413
If youâve thought this through, you might be asking: in the situation that an external server wants to talk to you first, how does that happen? It sends a packet to 146.7.15.85, and your routerâ¦
Oh no. It has no idea where to send it.
Working around it
Naturally, people noticed this was a problem almost immediately, because people have wanted to run game servers, FTP servers, and web servers from their bedrooms since roughly the beginning of time. So a whole ecosystem of workarounds grew up around NAT, none of which restore the fundamental intention of the internet, and none of which work for everything.
Port forwarding
The most direct fix is to just tell your router âhey, when a packet comes in on port 60612, send it to 10.11.70.21 on port 50413, no questions asked.â This is port forwarding, and itâs the workaround to NAT that the most people are aware of. One of the problems with port forwarding, conceptually, is that one public IP+port can still only map to one device
at a time
, which means that two devices canât operate a service on the same public IP+port at the same time. This is more of a problem than it sounds like; on big enterprise or university networks that choke down to a small number or even just one private IP, this basically kills onâprem hosting without doing even more complicated shit. And sometimes, your ISP has put
your external IP
behind NAT tooâââwhich is called carrierâgrade NAT (CGNAT)âââand now you donât control the device doing the translation, so you canât forward a port. Youâre getting a fraction of a fraction of an IP address.
Also, another problem with NAT is that
nobody wants to bother with it
, which is why we invented:
UPnP
UPnP, and its modern cousins NATâPMP and PCP, tried to solve the ânobody wants to bother with itâ problem by letting software ask the router directly to forward ports. Like manual port forwarding, itâs a request to
your
routerâââif your ISP is screwing with you, youâre out of luck. Itâs also frequently disabled because of misguided

data.title: Reverse engineering my ADHD test
data.author: hazebooth
data.article_summary: 作者因怀疑自己患有多动症接受在线测试，测试要求在干扰声画中识别红心并按空格键。出于好奇，作者逆向分析网页代码，发现系统记录按键时间、错误操作、失去焦点等数据，并根据年龄组调整帧率、图片和声音。文章揭示了测试的技术实现及其评估注意力的方式。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：成人ADHD的诊断测试是否可靠，以及确诊、用药和求医过程中的个人体验。

不同观点：
• 确诊者认为，童年起长期的拖延、走神、难以完成琐事是ADHD的应对与合理化；测试中会因分析评分、走神或焦躁而疲惫，诊断结合长时间访谈和童年经历比单一测试更重要。药物能提升动力，但可能放大自闭特征或造成情感麻木。
• 一些人认为测试不能代表真实能力：有人准确率100%、反应快，却因抖腿、敲桌等行为被判断异常；也有人因熟悉电子游戏而得出“神经典型”结果，质疑测试对玩家或高认知者的区分度。
• 求诊者关注机构质量参差不齐：问诊困难、候诊机构评分很低，只提供过时问卷或线上测试，因此怀疑流程不专业，并询问是否需要跨州寻找医生。
• 研究与行业批评者指出，ADHD和自闭症目前缺乏可靠生物标志物，问卷和小样本研究证据有限；测试可能更多服务于保险、责任和管制药物审批。
• 有人担忧兴奋剂会引发依赖、耐受及长期反作用，认为“多巴胺不足”的解释过度简化；也有人询问测试开源的法律风险。

补充讨论：评论之间的核心争议是，行为测试究竟能否有效支持诊断，还是只能作为访谈、病史和临床观察的辅助工具；眼动追踪、深度学习被视为未来方向，但短期内仍不确定。

49467700.article_content:
Reverse Engineering My ADHD Test
Thu Aug 27 2026
authored by
veritas
Stargazing
One night, while chatting with friends, I looked up and noticed the stars. Light pollution usually makes them difficult to see, so I was surprised by how clear it all was. I stared for several minutes before deciding,
"I need a telescope." I ordered one on Amazon that same night. I've always picked up new hobbies this way. However, I could never stick with them.
Celestron NexStar 5SE telescope photographed from my roof.
I chalked it up to being a spontaneous person. It wasn't until a friend shared their recent autism diagnosis that I decided to get evaluated for ADHD. The psychiatrist explained that getting evaluated was a good idea. "Untreated ADHD can sometimes go hand in hand with depression and anxiety", she told me. She had me take an online assessment, warning me that once it began, she wouldn't
be able to talk to me. Unsure of what I was about to experience, I clicked the "Begin Test" link sent to my email.
Taking the test
The link brought me to a blank page with what felt like an early-2000s Flash game. The task was simple: press Space whenever a card with three red hearts appeared, otherwise, do nothing.
I sat there pressing the spacebar as instructed. There was no timer or score to keep track of, only flashing
cards. Eventually, other pieces of clip art began appearing alongside them, seemingly as a way to distract me. Still, I followed
the task of pressing my spacebar when the card with three red hearts appeared. This dragged on, eventually introducing audio of crying

49467700.article_summary: 作者因怀疑自己患有多动症接受在线测试，测试要求在干扰声画中识别红心并按空格键。出于好奇，作者逆向分析网页代码，发现系统记录按键时间、错误操作、失去焦点等数据，并根据年龄组调整帧率、图片和声音。文章揭示了测试的技术实现及其评估注意力的方式。
49467700.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：成人ADHD的诊断测试是否可靠，以及确诊、用药和求医过程中的个人体验。

不同观点：
• 确诊者认为，童年起长期的拖延、走神、难以完成琐事是ADHD的应对与合理化；测试中会因分析评分、走神或焦躁而疲惫，诊断结合长时间访谈和童年经历比单一测试更重要。药物能提升动力，但可能放大自闭特征或造成情感麻木。
• 一些人认为测试不能代表真实能力：有人准确率100%、反应快，却因抖腿、敲桌等行为被判断异常；也有人因熟悉电子游戏而得出“神经典型”结果，质疑测试对玩家或高认知者的区分度。
• 求诊者关注机构质量参差不齐：问诊困难、候诊机构评分很低，只提供过时问卷或线上测试，因此怀疑流程不专业，并询问是否需要跨州寻找医生。
• 研究与行业批评者指出，ADHD和自闭症目前缺乏可靠生物标志物，问卷和小样本研究证据有限；测试可能更多服务于保险、责任和管制药物审批。
• 有人担忧兴奋剂会引发依赖、耐受及长期反作用，认为“多巴胺不足”的解释过度简化；也有人询问测试开源的法律风险。

补充讨论：评论之间的核心争议是，行为测试究竟能否有效支持诊断，还是只能作为访谈、病史和临床观察的辅助工具；眼动追踪、深度学习被视为未来方向，但短期内仍不确定。

data.title: The safest job from AI may be writing
data.author: ilreb
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI能否替代写作及其他创意工作，以及“写作有价值”是否等于“写作是安全职业”。

不同观点：
• **就业冲击论**：AI未必需要达到顶尖人类水平，只要能完成新闻、翻译、技术写作、企业宣传、文案和校对等“够用”的工作，就会削弱作家赖以谋生的基础，已有作者失业；企业往往更看重低成本和表面专业感，而非文笔质量。  
• **人类创作不可替代论**：优秀写作者的核心是意图、思想、情感和对每个词的 deliberate 选择。模型只能依据提示和训练数据生成，缺乏真正意图，容易产出千篇一律、情节混乱或缺乏深度的内容；代码、音乐、绘画也存在类似问题。  
• **辅助工具论**：模型目前不擅长情节、情绪及时间和知识关系，但擅长校对逻辑、验证设定、模拟角色、整理复杂结构和润色语言。人类负责创意与统筹，AI负责扩展和审查，普通作者也可能借此创作高水平作品。  
• **有限安全论**：文学声望写作的需求可能长期存在，且人类能识别AI痕迹；但“写作仍有价值”不代表“写作岗位安全”。有人认为写作本来就不是稳定职业，只有难以被训练数据捕捉、规则不明的工作更安全。

补充讨论：争议焦点在于“质量差异是否能转化为付费需求”。即使人类能辨别优劣，企业和大众未必愿意为差异买单；LinkedIn与X上的互动差异被用作人类内容仍更受欢迎的例子，但这未必能阻止企业持续削减成本。

主要讨论点：数学、软件开发等智力职业中的挫折感、坚持与成就意义，以及人工智能对个人价值和工作方式的冲击。

不同观点：
• 许多人认为，持续面对不会解决的问题、容忍失败并坚持下去，正是数学和软件开发的核心乐趣与生存条件；有人因此逐渐减少使用 AI，认为 AI 消除阻力后，解决问题的成就感也随之下降。  
• 有观点强调，研究价值不只属于天才或重大突破。数学家受限于时间和注意力，普通人通过增量成果、数值实验和局部问题，也能推动领域发展；“平庸”和日常工作同样有意义。  
• 另一种看法认为，AI 仍可能通过处理人类未关注、较琐碎的问题发挥作用，但短期内哪些问题必须保留人在环中，仍有待探索。  
• 有人认为“失败”比长期处于“可能成功”的灰色地带更容易接受；也有人担心 AI 和竞争会进一步贬低普通人的贡献。  
• 对“数学教学是在撒谎”存在争议：一方认为教学常通过简化甚至“谎言”建立直觉，另一方反驳称这只是有意简化，不应称为欺骗。

补充讨论：多位评论者赞赏文章文笔和真实的人声；也有人指出，作者对数学的描述同样适用于软件开发及其他职业。有人把 AI 比作兴趣中那个不断炫耀、削弱他人乐趣的强势伙伴。

49514895.article_content:
Recently, we needed to add observability to a Rails project without getting
locked into a single vendor. OpenTelemetry was the natural choice.
It generates three kinds of telemetry data, called
signals
: logs, metrics,
and traces. Each signal is independent, so you can adopt one without the others.
All of these signals travel in a standard, vendor-agnostic format known as OTLP
(OpenTelemetry Protocol). Because this format is standard across the industry,
we can switch backends (like Datadog, New Relic, or Grafana Cloud) in the future
without rewriting any application code.
In this post, we will explain how we configured the OpenTelemetry Ruby SDK to
export logs directly to our vendor, Grafana Cloud. We will also discuss a few
issues we encountered along the way and the upstream fixes we contributed.
Exporting directly to the vendor
The standard OpenTelemetry deployment involves running an
OpenTelemetry
Collector
alongside your application. The Collector is a separate process,
usually a sidecar container or a service on the same host. Your application
sends telemetry to it over the local network, and the Collector then batches
that data and forwards it to the vendor.
To keep our infrastructure simple, we bypassed the Collector and exported logs
directly from the Ruby SDK to Grafana Cloud. The
Scout APM logging gem
uses
a similar approach and sends logs directly from the app.
Our log volume is small, so the SDK's built-in batching is enough. A Collector
is still the better choice if you need buffering, sampling, or scrubbing outside
the app.
Setting up the Ruby SDK for logs
Add the following gems to your
Gemfile
:
gem
"opentelemetry-sdk"
gem
"opentelemetry-logs-sdk"
gem
"opentelemetry-exporter-otlp"
gem
"opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-logs"
gem
"opentelemetry-instrumentation-all"
gem
"opentelemetry-instrumentation-logger"
OpenTelemetry is highly modular, so each gem handles a specific responsibility:
opentelemetry-sdk
: The core OpenTelemetry framework (traces and the
configuration entry point).
opentelemetry-logs-sdk
: Adds support for the logging signal (which is
separate from traces).
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp
: Exports traces over the network via OTLP.
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-logs
: Exports logs over the network via OTLP.
opentelemetry-instrumentation-all
: Bundles the instrumentation gems,
including Rails, Rack, and Active Record.
opentelemetry-instrumentation-logger
: Hooks into the standard Ruby
Logger
so log messages become OpenTelemetry log records.
With these gems installed, the exporter needs to know where to send the data.
Set your vendor's endpoint and authentication token as environment variables
(the SDK automatically detects
standard OTLP exporter environment variables
):
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
=
"https://your-vendor.com/otlp"
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS
=
"Authorization=Basic <your-token>"
Finally, we need to initialize the SDK so it starts collecting and exporting
data. Create an initializer (
config/initializers/opentelemetry.rb
):
return
if
ENV
[
"OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT"
].
blank?
OpenTelemetry
::
SDK
.
configure
do
|
c
|
c.
service_name
=
"our-rails-app"
c.
use_all
end
Here,
c.use_all
enables every instrumentation that has been required, which
means the ones bundled in
opentelemetry-instrumentation-all
plus
opentelemetry-instrumentation-logger
.
Testing it locally
Now that the SDK is configured, you can test it by setting
OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=console
. This prints log records in your terminal instead
of sending them to the vendor, which is the quickest way to confirm your setup
works before deploying.
Issues we found and fixed in the Ruby SDK
When we exported logs to Grafana Cloud, we found two issues where the Ruby SDK
behaved differently than other language SDKs and the OpenTelemetry
specification.
1. Exporter dropped the base path
Some vendor backends require sending OTLP data to an endpoint with a specific
base path
, such as
/otlp
in our case with Grafana Cloud, but the exporter
dropped it while appending the signal path.
Endpoint:  https://your-vendor.com/otlp
Expected:  https://your-vendor.com/otlp/v1/logs
Actual:    https://your-vendor.com/v1/logs
We reported this in
issue #2157
and fixed it in
PR #2158
,
which was released in
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-logs
v0.5.1.
2. Handling HTTP 204 responses
Grafana Cloud returns
204 No Content
after ingesting logs, but the exporter
only treated
200 OK
as success. The exports actually succeeded, but our app
logged each one as a failure.
We raised
issue #2043
and fixed it in
PR #2044
,
which was released in
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-logs
v0.4.0.
Next steps: structured logging
Now that logs are being successfully exported, the next logical step is
structured logging. That's too much to cover here, but the
rails_semantic_logger
gem is a great place to start, and we might even cover the full OpenTelemetry
setup for it in a future post!
